exposure: maternal age (very advanced: 45-49 years; extremely advanced: >=50 years)
mode of conception (spontaneous vs. assisted reproductive technology [ART])
oocyte source in ART (homologous vs. heterologous)
outcome: maternal morbidity (cesarean delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, gestational diabetes, manual placental removal)
cohort: The study included 557 women aged 45 years or older with singleton pregnancies delivered at or after 22 weeks' gestation across five Italian academic hospitals between 2016 and 2022.
finding: ART pregnancies in women aged 45 years or older are associated with increased maternal morbidity, particularly when involving heterologous oocytes, compared to spontaneous conceptions.
mod_finding: ART pregnancies were associated with significantly higher odds of cesarean delivery compared to spontaneous conceptions.
